```{r}
#| label: setup
here::i_am("text/quarto_test.qmd")
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)

# Quarto runs the code from the folder of this document (text/), so the
# relative path "data/raw/airquality.csv" would not be found. here() starts
# from the project root instead.
air_data <- read_csv(file = here("data/raw/airquality.csv")) |>
  filter(Month > 5)
```

# Introduction {#sec-intro}

This document is meant as an *illustration*.
The data are described in @sec-data, their visualisation in @sec-vis.

# Data {#sec-data}

These are **data**!

Here we use data from @chambers1983.
An overview is given in @tbl-data.

<!-- The label prefix tbl- makes the table cross-referenceable. -->

```{r}
#| label: tbl-data
#| cap-location: top
#| tbl-cap: "Overview of the data."
head(air_data) |>
  flextable() |>
  autofit() |>
  theme_vanilla()
```

The data have been collected [@chambers1983].

<!-- Hard-coded: wrong as soon as the data change. Inline code is computed at
     every render. -->

The average temperature is 77.88.
Better: `r round(mean(air_data$Temp), 2)`.

A visualisation is shown in @fig-airplot.

```{r}
#| label: fig-airplot
#| fig-cap: "The temperature across months."
air_data_plot <- ggplot(
  data = air_data,
  mapping = aes(x = Day, y = Temp, color = as_factor(Month))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  theme_minimal()
air_data_plot
```
